approximation_rule_note: Image-level paired bootstrap CIs were not run; tiny C05-C0 effects are therefore treated as practically neutral from magnitude and mixed-sign evidence, not as a formal CI result.

cases.evidence: C0 is not approximately P on Medical pixel metrics and C05-C0 is not a positive material effect.
cases.name: CLEAN_RMT_WIN

cases.evidence: C05-C0 is neutral, but the case premise C0 approximately P is not met for pixel transfer.
cases.name: RMT_NEUTRAL

cases.evidence: C05-C0 is slightly negative for most Medical macro epochs but the magnitude is at most 0.0114 percentage points and is not consistent enough for a material AP-harm claim.
cases.name: AP_HARM

cases.evidence: The small negative C05-C0 pixel effect does not explain the C0-P gap; inference transport is effectively neutral.
cases.name: INFERENCE_RMT_HARMFUL

cases.evidence: C0 pixel AUROC/AP is below P at every macro epoch; C05 does not recover either metric.
cases.name: CIR_TRAINING_HARMS_REPRESENTATION

cases.evidence: C0 source Pixel AP exceeds P at all source epochs, but the effect does not transfer to Medical pixel scores.
cases.name: TRAINING_HELPS_INFERENCE_DOES_NOT

cases.evidence: C05 remains below P on Medical pixel macro metrics.
cases.name: TRAINING_HURTS_INFERENCE_RECOVERS

cases.evidence: The observed direction is mostly the reverse: C0 image AUROC is often better while pixel metrics are weaker.
cases.name: PIXEL_GOOD_IMAGE_WEAK

cases.evidence: Image metrics are comparatively stronger, while Medical Pixel AP remains the clearest residual weakness.
cases.name: IMAGE_GOOD_PIXEL_AP_WEAK

cases.evidence: Liver improves versus P while Retina/ClinicDB/Kvasir decline and Brain/ColonDB are mixed; no domain-specific alpha rule is permitted.
cases.name: DOMAIN_FLIP

cases.evidence: P is not universally weak: it is a stronger pixel-transfer baseline than C0, although the target problem itself remains difficult.
cases.name: PARENT_UPSTREAM_FAILURE
